verdict.rationale: Conta Simples' own API lets a programmatic user pull card and bank statements, credit card bills, categories, cost centers, users and suppliers, and download receipts and linked files. That is a real but piecemeal path to getting data out. There is no documented bulk export, the open formats returned are not stated, and nothing addresses account closure. Missing for 10: documented full-account or bulk export, explicit open formats (e.g., CSV/OFX/JSON schema), offboarding/account-closure guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Access card and bank statements, download receipts, update and reconcile transactions.
Link receipts and invoices to existing transactions and download the linked files.
List credit card bills and view the details of each bill.
